title: Define article root node DAG-CBOR schema
description: Specify the Rust types and field layout for the article root node in usenet-ipfs-core. The root node contains: header_cid (Cid), body_cid (Cid), mime_cid (Option<Cid>), and a metadata struct. Include a schema_version field for forward compatibility. Canonical serialization must follow RFC 8785 + Corundum Chapter 31 conventions (sorted keys, NFKC normalization, UTC timestamps, no whitespace). Codec choice (DAG-CBOR vs DAG-JSON) is deferred to spike l62.2.9.10 — schema defined here is codec-independent.
